title: "UFO Sightings: Objects Seen in Wanaque, Newark" - Newark Evening News, 10/11/66
description: Newspaper clipping mounted on FBI form FD-350 headlined "UFO Sightings" with subhead "Objects Seen in Wanaque, Newark," from the Newark Evening News, Newark, N.J., dated 10/11/66 (Wall St. edition). The article reports a large shining object hovering over the Wanaque reservoir seen by police and residents, with subheads "Object Disappears" and "Had Been Seen Before." The form carries the FBI Newark indexing stamp dated Oct 12 1966 and file number 100-36998-40.
